title: Unnamed Suit 030/Quotes
summary:
"If you wait, I will notify my superior as to your presence. He will be delighted, I'm sure."
- Suit 030 to Dante Vale, (All Work and No Pay)

"Master Klaus is most excited to see you."
- Suit 030 to the Huntik team, (All Work and No Pay)

"Foolish men! Invoke more Titans!"
- Suit 030 to his men, (The Sceptre Deception)
